data_kind: Observed PNSD after project quality control, expressed as number concentration per native size bin (Delta N), not dN/dlog10Dp.
time: Timestamps are retained from the analysis input without rounding; retain their source precision.
missing_values: Blank CSV fields are missing values; all-missing integration windows remain missing.
DF: Corresponding MPPD-derived tabulated deposition fractions used in the study. HA=head airways; TB=tracheobronchial; ALV=alveolar. Use the tabulated Total column to reproduce the calculation; independently rounded component columns need not add exactly to Total.
example_scope: Complete available processed BCN_UB PNSD record. Spatial statistics use 2015-2019.
